quarterly_data.quarter: Lenovo press release: Lenovo AI Express with NVIDIA Accelerates Path to Hybrid AI (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lenovo launched Lenovo AI Express, a quick-start path to the Lenovo Hybrid AI Factory with NVIDIA, with order-to-ship accelerating to 15 business days for eligible configurations. Three validated configurations: Small (from 15 days) on ThinkSystem SR650a V4 with two NVIDIA RTX 6000 PRO Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, for inferencing for tens of users at 30+ TPS with 7B-70B models; Medium (from 20 days) on ThinkSystem SR675 V3 with eight RTX 6000 PRO Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, for hundreds of users with 70B-400B models; Large (from 25 days) on ThinkSystem SR680a V4 powered by NVIDIA HGX B300, for thousands of users with up to a trillion parameters. Configurations also support AMD and Intel CPUs; availability, eligibility and ordering vary by region, and the program is also offered through channel partners. ISG President Ashley Gorakhpurwalla: AI Express gives customers 'an accelerated path to deploying AI infrastructure ... while mitigating the risk of overbuilding or costly delays'.
quarterly_data.figure: order-to-ship from 15 / 20 / 25 days (Small / Medium / Large); 2 or 8 RTX 6000 PRO Blackwell GPUs; HGX B300
